MYOSOTIS SYMPHYTIFOLIA
Forget-me-not
(MYOSOTIS)

Chronic bronchitis and phthisis. Night-sweats.

Respiratory.--Cough with profuse muco-purulent expectoration, gagging and vomiting during cough; worse while or after eating. Bronchorrhśa. Pain in left lung (lower); painful while coughing and sensitive to percussion.

Dose.--Tincture to second potency.
